author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I refuse to set a slash command for one liner in Claude Code

Typing out the simple instructions like, "commit, push, PR and merge" is a healthy dose of slowdown in my super-fast-paced AI coding session.  Typing a /cppm may save 2 seconds in typing, but it actually adds extra cognitive burden to my brain.
